description: This file defines a class 'FormatWithGender' that implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface, providing a method to format gender values for Employee entities based on their gender attribute. It is part of a maintenance access strategy within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: FormatWithGender
classes.description: Implements value formatting for gender attributes, providing formatted string based on Employee's gender value.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the formatted gender string based on the entity value, or null if not set.
